full_bleed_world.name: Full-Bleed World Canvas
full_bleed_world.description: Entire game canvas is a rich continuous landscape behind HUD reaching all 4 edges

main_citadel.name: Main Citadel
main_citadel.description: Huge vertical gothic/medieval stone castle with slender towers, lower terraces, warm torch/window lights, green-gold dragon banners, arched bridges

dragon_roost.name: Dragon Roost
dragon_roost.description: Massive perched olive/bronze dragon, long neck angled profile, torn gold-green wing membranes, perched atop substantial stone tower fortress on cliff

settlement.name: Dense Medieval Settlement Quarter
settlement.description: Dense inhabited quarter with timber/stone roofs, winding lanes, stairs, central cloaked monument statue, forge glow, fields, market, smoke, trees

fortifications.name: Foreground Fortifications
fortifications.description: Articulated foreground crenellated stone walls with buttresses, towers, gatehouses integrated with cliffs

natural_environment.name: Natural Environment & Harbor
natural_environment.description: Snow-capped alpine mountains, pine forests, atmospheric mist, waterfalls, right-side sea inlet/harbor, arched bridge and ships

brand_logo_hud.name: Brand / Logo HUD
brand_logo_hud.description: Carved dark-metal dragon standard, DragonWake gold logotype, 'A STRONGER TOMORROW' subtitle

top_resources.name: Top Resource Bar
top_resources.description: Black/aged-metal beveled horizontal bar with gold coin, wood, stone, ingot, red crystal, plus button

upper_right_controls.name: Upper-Right Controls
upper_right_controls.description: Ornamented icon row: helmet profile, alliance, mail with notification dot, menu

left_rail.name: Left Portrait & Rail
left_rail.description: Painted commander portrait, Realm Lv. indicator with progress bar, stacked square ornamental buttons

right_objective_card.name: Right Objective Card
right_objective_card.description: Inset illustrated castle tile and 'Forges Stronger Realms >' interactive objective card

bottom_dock.name: Bottom Dock
bottom_dock.description: Five round embossed icon buttons: Build, Muster, Forge, Roost, Map

bottom_message_strip.name: Bottom Message / Quest Strip
bottom_message_strip.description: Ornate message strip with scroll icon: 'A greater realm rises.'
